historical_record.summary: Small oil companies at Third and 18th
historical_record.description: A cluster of small oil-company buildings, put up to serve the Central Waterfront's larger industries, stood around the Third and 18th Street intersection; two of them were at 550 18th Street and 2075 Third Street.
